Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front: yes on split invoices with a weekly early window, yes on providing sample PO language, and yes we can outline a prorate approach for ramp months. A few details and two options for discounts so procurement/finance can pick the model that fits your AP flows.

Quick clarifications we need from you to lock pricing:
- Is the Bill-To entity exactly "Medsure Operating, Inc." for the PO header?
- Do you have a BU / GL code that must appear on every invoice line? If so, share the label and expected format.

Pricing options (indicative):
1) Prepay model (preferred for discount): 12-month prepay = 10% off list serving rates + priority onboarding cap. Invoices issued on receipt of PO (one prepay invoice) then monthly reconciliation credits applied. Net 30.
2) Commitment + invoice cadence: Standard monthly billing, with an early 90-day weekly invoice option during ramp. If you commit to annual spend >= $500k, we can extend a 5% committed-spend discount; we will prorate the discount across monthly statements and perform a reconciliation at quarter close. Net 30 baseline, can flex to Net 45 for multi-entity billing with advance notice.

Prorate approach for ramp month example: if committed slab is 100k/month and ramp month usage is 40k, we apply the discount on the 40k and invoice weekly; at month-end we reconcile to determine whether credits or additional invoices are required. We can share a spreadsheet to illustrate — attaching the pricing matrix v3 for reference (sample numbers only).

PO clause (informal):
"Vendor shall reference purchaser PO number on each invoice. Invoices issued during the initial ninety (90) day ramp period may be submitted weekly and will be consolidated into a monthly statement for ERP posting. Any prepayments will be applied as credits to subsequent invoices and reconciled monthly. Net payment terms are thirty (30) days from invoice date unless otherwise agreed in writing."

Next steps I suggest: Vanessa will confirm whether the legal/accounting teams require any special ledger fields on our invoices. If that looks good, I can put a formal quote + sample PO clause in DocuSign and we can route to your procurement contact for PO issuance.

Thanks —
Ben

Forwarding with a couple of compliance notes. Ben / Elaine —

We can accept weekly invoices during the 90-day ramp and provide a consolidated monthly statement for ERP posting. A couple of constraints from finance/legal: 
- For prepay discounts, our standard is to issue a single prepay invoice up front and then monthly credit reconciliation; we need the PO to explicitly reference "Prepayment" if that path is chosen.
- If Medsure requests Net 45, we need an internal credit approval (Karthik and finance will process). Net45 is acceptable for annual commitments >= $750k or with a purchase order that includes billing guarantees.
- We can add a PO clause to require the PO number on the invoice and an optional "AP reference" custom field — please provide the exact BU/GL label so we can include it on invoices.

I've copied Karthik to handle credit approval and to confirm our ability to accept the BU code in our billing system. Ben — once you send the formal quote, include the sample PO language exactly as you want it to appear in the DocuSign addendum so procurement can paste it into the PO.
